div.h1: Where Arabian Heritage Meets Kerala Soul
div.p: Aesthetic cafe featuring multicuisine dishes and signature Arabian specialties. Slow-cooked Kuzhimanthi, charcoal-seared Al Faham, freshly pulled rumali shawarmas, golden Turkish Kunafa, and specialty roasts in the heart of Kanjirappally.

div.h2: Handcrafted Spices, Charcoal Embers & Warm Hospitality
div.p: Located on the Kottayam–Kumily highway corridor at 26th Mile Bridge, Ayshu's Culinary Restaurant is built on a passion for authentic culinary traditions.

From slow-steamed Kuzhimanthi prepared with aged Basmati rice and whole spices, to charcoal Al Faham seared to smoky perfection over open coals, every recipe is prepared fresh daily. Whether you are stopping for a quick artisan coffee in our cozy aesthetic cafe lounge or gathering your entire family for an evening banquet, you will find warmth in every detail.
Prepared with freshly hand-ground Malabar spices, heritage dum techniques, and authentic Arabian marinades.
Slow-steamed spiced basmati rice and charcoal-smoked tender chicken, served with spicy tomato salsa & creamy garlic toum.
Chicken infused with freshly cracked Malabar black pepper, garlic & Arabic herbs, char-grilled over live embers with kuboos.
Traditional Jeerakasala kaima rice layered with slow-cooked chicken masala, golden fried onions, ghee, raita & date pickle.
Crisp golden spun kataifi pastry stuffed with gooey melted cheese, drenched in aromatic orange blossom syrup & pistachios.
Single-estate espresso pulled fresh, sweetened condensed milk, velvety micro-foam, served hot or iced in our cafe lounge.
Fresh elaneer pulp blended with thick dairy cream and vanilla ice-cream. The ultimate soothing cooler on the highway.
